design_philosophy.core_vibe: Futuristic, smooth, highly responsive, one-hand usability, zero clutter.
design_philosophy.e1_rationale: Using a performance-driven 'Tactical Neon' design. The dark background ensures zero glare during night rides, while the neon #00E5FF provides high-contrast peripheral visibility without forcing the user to focus on the screen.

primary.usage: Speedometer numbers, large toggle text, Paywall headers.
primary.e1_note: User requested Poppins or Inter. I have selected Inter for all data and body text. However, for the massive Speed numbers, 'Outfit' is specified to bring the 'Futuristic/Neon' velocity feel that Poppins lacks. If strict adherence is needed, use Poppins Bold for headings.

layout_and_spacing.alignment: Vertical-center dominance for driving focus. Important elements must be reachable with one thumb in the lower 60% of the screen.

main_toggle_button.animation: Continuous subtle scale pulse (0.98 to 1.02) when ON. Ripple effect on press.

mode_selector.inactive_pill: Background: transparent, Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2), Text: rgba(255,255,255,0.8)

window_level_slider.visibility: Only visible when Driving mode is active
window_level_slider.label: Window Level: 0-100%

Main.layout: Column layout, spaced out. Top: Speed. Center: Giant Toggle. Bottom: Mode Selector, Slider (conditional), Status Text ('Auto Volume: ON', 'Free Mode (Ad every 15 min)').

items: Custom Speed-to-Volume mapping graph (Interactive Chart area)

real_time_feedback_panel.content: Mini dashboard showing Speed, Noise Level (dB), Current Volume %

Paywall.background: Image overlay with deep #0A0A0A gradient fade at bottom.
Paywall.content: Large bold value prop ('Unleash Pro Flow'), Glassmorphism pricing cards.
Paywall.cta_button: Full width pill, background #00E5FF, text #0A0A0A, 'Start Free Trial'

motion_and_animations.speed_counter: Reanimated smoothly interpolating numbers to avoid jitter.
motion_and_animations.toggle_pulse: React Native Reanimated repeating pulse (scale & opacity) on the shadow wrapper when active.
motion_and_animations.transitions: Fade-in and slide-up for mode switching (e.g., when 'Window Level' slider appears).
motion_and_animations.press_interactions: All touchables scale down to 0.95 on press-in and restore on press-out.

testing.requirements: ALL interactive elements (buttons, sliders, toggles, mode pills) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='main-start-toggle', data-testid='mode-cycling-btn').

paywall_backgrounds.description: Night cyclist in motion, perfect dark base for Paywall contextual background.
Blurred car lights at night, suitable for driving mode context or alternate paywall background.
